summary: Fomento Económico Mexicano (FEMSA) filed a Form 6-K announcing the availability of its annual report on Form 20-F for fiscal year 2025 with the U.S. SEC and its corresponding annual report with Mexican regulators. This is a routine annual reporting requirement for a foreign private issuer under the 1934 Act. No special-situation event—such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC activity, or management change—is disclosed. The filing is purely informational and procedural.
